Portrait setting: Training Ground Gamma, U.A.'s mock industrial district. Behind the character, a narrow lane winds between tangled steel pipes, rounded storage tanks and boxy plant buildings; catwalks and ladders cross overhead at several heights, and the maze closes off the view in every direction under an overcast sky. Weathered paint, rust streaks and concrete underfoot. No other people. No readable signs or text.

Scenery only: the choice does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame and keep exactly one foreground character.

Portrait lighting — Key: Broad overcast skylight from above, soft and gray-white. Fill: Diffuse light scattered between the pipes and tank walls. Bounce: Dull light off the concrete and painted steel. Practical: A few caged work lamps on the catwalks, warm points against the gray.
